label: Figure 12.5: Productive and allocative efficiency in monopoly
alt: The monopolist's profit-maximizing output q1 (MC=MR) restricted below both the allocatively efficient output q2 (where D=AR meets MC) and the productively efficient output q3 (minimum of AC).
caption: The monopolist produces at the profit-maximizing output q<sub>1</sub> (MC = MR), earning the shaded abnormal profit rectangle. This output is restricted below both the allocatively efficient output q<sub>2</sub> (where D = AR meets MC, so P = MC) and the productively efficient output q<sub>3</sub> (the minimum point of AC). Because q<sub>1</sub> is less than either, output is restricted purely to raise price and maximize profit — neither productive nor allocative efficiency is achieved.
